== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The graveyard is a specific location situated at the [[House of Blades]]. Its inclusion was a requirement demanded by an individual known as the [[The Wanderer|Wanderer]], despite the fact that honoring deceased individuals is not a standard practice within [[Nye]] traditions. The site currently contains eight headstones made of gray stone or granite, featuring names carved in a crude style, though the area is large enough to accommodate many more. The graveyard serves a functional purpose for those seeking [[ghost armor]], which provides defense against the abilities of other [[Travelers]]. It is also a location where ghosts can be found and where certain tests may occur. The grounds are characterized by grass and a door that can be closed, and the area has been overseen by guardians such as the [[Eldest]].}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The graveyard was established following the insistence of the [[The Wanderer|Wanderer]]. This location is supported by stone arches and columns that resemble an ancient coliseum, housing eight headstones carved from gray stone. Within the site, stormclouds emit emerald light and bright green lightning. Currently, [[Rebekkah]] remains stuck within the graveyard.}}
